messages:
Priya: FYI external pentest scheduled for 2026-05-14 09:00-16:30 UTC. We need a permission-lockdown window, KMS access via proxy, immutable audit export, and a single evidence handoff owner. Can we split ownership?

Dave: I can own the permission-lockdown (I'll call it lockdown window) and rollback procedures. Proposal: lockdown 08:30-17:00 UTC to allow buffer windows. Will enumerate all service principals impacted.

Maria: KMS plan: don't export or share key material. Use a decryption proxy role that can be assumed by assessor acct. We will scope Decrypt to the S3 object path only. Need assessor AWS account and S3 prefixes.

Luis: Assessors: acct 555566667777. We'll publish a signed manifest that lists allowed prefixes and presigned object URLs for evidence bundles. Recommend tar+sha256 for integrity.

Priya: Prefer a timeboxed readroom: publish a read-only presigned bundle + sha256, no persistent credentials. Also want object-lock enabled on target bucket for the snapshot objects.

Ops Bot: Ticket created SEC-PT-5010: lockdown window + KMS-proxy + readroom packaging. Owners: @Dave, @Maria. Initial artifact ETA: 36h.

Dave: Draft permission snippet (will tighten to exact ARNs):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::pt-readroom/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

I'll produce per-prefix ARNs and include a deny for s3:PutObject.

Maria: KMS policy pattern: allow kms:Decrypt when aws:SourceAccount = "555566667777" and kms:ViaService = "s3.amazonaws.com". We'll ensure key policy blocks iam:PassRole to prevent credential escalation.

Priya: Audit needs: regional CloudTrail on + object-locked snapshots. Platform: can you export a compressed snapshot of the 08:30-17:00 window and provide checksum? Also include filtered host logs and alert snapshots.

Luis: Yes — we'll generate pt-readroom/snapshots/2098765432_window.tar.gz and publish pt-readroom/manifests/2098765432.sha256. SIEM snapshot and filtered host logs included. Retain exports for 90 days.

Zoe: Oncall check: if assessors trigger noisy traffic or host alerts, we should have a rate limiting approach and a contact path. Who's primary triage?

Priya: Dave primary triage, Maria backup. If a blocker is found that affects customer-facing systems, follow incident escalation to oncall bridge and tag as P1. We'll use the incident runbook IR-2025.

Dave: I'll schedule a procedural dry-run Fri morning to validate lockdown + manifest generation + checksum. Who can validate the manifest?

Maria: I'll validate KMS conditions and that no key rotations happen. Ops please pause rotation for alias/pt-readroom-key during the window.

Ops Bot: Rotation paused for alias/pt-readroom-key from 2026-05-14T06:00Z to 2026-05-14T20:00Z. Note appended to SEC-PT-5010.

Priya: Acceptance criteria: everyone add one-liners to SEC-PT-5010 by EOD. Example: "Snapshot exported + sha256 checksum verified" or "Assessors only able to decrypt via proxy and only for designated prefixes." Pre-check call Tue 09:00 UTC 15m.

Dave: Added: "Lockdown applied, rollback tested, dry-run completed."

Maria: Added: "KMS proxy enforced, key rotations suppressed."

Luis: Added: "Snapshot created, checksum published, SIEM capture included."

Zoe: Added: "Triage path validated, rate-limit plan acknowledged."

Priya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in the pre-check. Ping here for any late changes. :white_check_mark:
